# Noqeri UI components 0.2.2

- Preserves all 106 existing components and the stable dependency pins for backwards compatibility.
- Adds SkipToMain, LiveStatus (ARIA polite status) and ScreenReaderText for accessible, semantics-first native views.
- CSS focus-visible skip navigation and reduced-motion fallbacks.
- Expands source component-coverage fixture from 106 to 109 components.
- Native web compiler/DOM and browser accessibility verification remain required; no JS or Node.js dependency.
